(3) The remaining 6 residual entries are the rule-1-sanctioned offer-curve scope shared by every CALIBRATED keeper (offer_curve_by_group gas bands, smoothing shape) plus wefor pair / battery adder / merchant-CHP share, each carrying its open root-cause issue in this ledger.
